WITH joined_data AS (
  SELECT 
    u.acctscope,
    o.recordvault
  FROM riskandmargin rm
  INNER JOIN orders o ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault
  INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
),
scope_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    acctscope,
    COUNT(DISTINCT recordvault) as order_count
  FROM joined_data
  GROUP BY acctscope
)
SELECT 
  acctscope,
  order_count,
  CAST(order_count AS FLOAT) / CAST(SUM(order_count) OVER () AS FLOAT) as fraction_of_total,
  CAST(order_count AS FLOAT) / CAST(AVG(order_count) OVER () AS FLOAT) as divided_by_average
FROM scope_counts
ORDER BY acctscope;

assumptions.assumption: Users always have a defined (non-NULL) acctscope value. If NULL values exist in this column, they will be grouped as a separate scope category in results.
